questions.question: From which direction does Jeremiah 4 say disaster is coming?
What does God call the people to do to their hearts in Jeremiah 4?
options: Circumcise them, removing the foreskin of the heart
Harden them firmly against the coming of the enemy
Fill them entirely with the wisdom of the holy law
Offer them all up as a pleasing sacrifice to God
questions.answer: Circumcise them, removing the foreskin of the heart

questions.question: Jeremiah 4 describes the coming judgment as making the land desolate, like a return to formlessness.
